tldr: Mars in the 11th house: drive, energy, and assertion push into friends, community, and goals
body: Mars in the 11th house: drive, energy, and assertion push into friends, community, and goals. Gift: real force there. Watch: friction and impatience. With Mars in the 11th house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through friendship, community, networks, hopes, audiences, and the future. This makes how you belong, collaborate, and give your gifts to something larger than yourself a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through community and future vision.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in community and future vision.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
